verdict.rationale: Docs confirm referenced and unreferenced refunds via the Terminal API, and refunds can also be issued from the Customer Area dashboard, covering API and dashboard/POS terminal paths; however, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm partial-refund support or a direct point-of-sale terminal UI refund flow distinct from the API/dashboard. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of partial (vs only full) refund amounts, independent/hands-on verification of refund success from the physical terminal UI itself, and any community corroboration of the refund flow working as documented.
